source: backend/runner/src/e2e/probes/elicit-screens.e2e.ts, 2026-11-20, against the fake model; sandbox paths replaced
how: The model calls the probe MCP server's `form` tool (elicit-probe-server.mjs, its tools approved), which asks the person to fill the form in `schema`. `screens`: the form at three sizes. `steps`: the screen after each answering step in `keys` (a key pressed, or words submitted), and `after` 3 s later. `toolResult`: what the model read back. `novadeckSaw`: the terminal's requests while the form showed, before this reader. `approvals`: Codex's own approval of an MCP tool's call (a third-party server's tool with long names, and codex_tui's send_message_to_thread), approval mode `prompt`, at five sizes, then Esc; `novadeckSaw` the requests its hook raised. `subagent`: a spawned agent's form, drawn in the root's screen with the root idle, answered with 2; `rootTurnEnds` each second's requests as the root's turn (a `sleep 8`) ended under such a form, before this change, its request asked again under a new ref.
